1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 30 m de altura, de copa irregular y espesa, hojas alternas, flores pequeñas, aromáticas, de color verde o amarillo y fruto rojizo; se utiliza en la medicina tradicional. Burseraceae; Bursera simaruba.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 30 m with an irregular and dense canopy, alternate leaves, small aromatic flowers in shades of green or yellow, and reddish fruit; used in traditional medicine. Burseraceae; Bursera simaruba.
